original_suite.environment_note: Existing environment reused without installing kit constraints. FastAPI and Uvicorn exceed original kit declared upper bounds.

linkage.applicability: row_release; known source membership, trusted owner scoring lineage and replayable public QI transforms
linkage.metricUnit: verified unique correct matches / source targets
linkage.narrative: 75 of 480 source targets have a verified unique correct exact-match candidate under the declared public QI replay.
linkage.algorithm: Replay public QI transforms; exact candidate matching; private correspondence used only after matching to score correctness
assumptions: Target membership in the source cohort is known; one source row is treated as one target.
Target-known QI are correct and the deterministic transformation codebook is public.
The attacker never receives owner lineage; owner correspondence is used only to score precomputed matches.
The source target cohort is fully enumerated; suppressed targets remain in its denominator.
caveats: This is simulated source-target linkage, not independently validated external auxiliary-data linkage.
No population re-identification probability, unknown-membership false-positive calibration or release clearance is established.
Inapplicable replay is an uncovered attack, not zero risk; fuzzy or secret-compromise attacks may still apply.
The finite enumeration has no invented sampling confidence interval.
linkage.baselineDefinition: No independent nonmember control is available; uniform tie-breaking within a matched candidate set is reported only as a model comparator.
